“JOWNER VENDE FANTÁSTICO LOCAL EN CHAMBERÍ”

Espectacular local a pie de calle de 48m2, excelente ubicación.
Muy luminoso, buen estado de conservación y ubicado en una zona muy transitada, situado muy cerca de la parada de metro Islas Filipinas (L7). A su vez, hay multitud de líneas de autobús que te comunican con toda la capital. 
Características del local: 
- 48 m2. 
- Local con salida de humo.
- Licencia para 6 mesas.
- Excelente estado de conservación. 
- Zona muy transitada y bien comunicada.

inv.desc_en:
"JOWNER SELLS FANTASTIC PREMISES IN CHAMBERÍ"

Spectacular street-level premises of 48m2, excellent location.
Very bright, in good condition and located in a very busy area, situated very close to the Islas Filipinas metro stop (L7). In turn, there are many bus lines that connect you with the entire capital.
Features of the premises:
- 48 m2.
- Premises with smoke vent.
- License for 6 tables.
- Excellent state of conservation.
- Very busy and well-connected area.

Description of the surroundings:

This place is located in the heart of Chamberí, a residential neighborhood that enjoys a lot of tranquility and at the same time has a lot of life, both commercially, gastronomically and culturally. You can find all the essential services such as schools, pharmacies or traditional businesses. A classic atmosphere in the heart of Madrid.
